instruction: Like all the venmo transactions from yesterday involving any of my siblings on my venmo social feed.
notes: Two apps (phone for the contact book, venmo for the feed/likes) plus supervisor. Knowledge flow: show_profile gives the login usernames (email for venmo, phone number for phone), show_account_passwords gives passwords, phone.search_contacts with query/relationship 'sibling' yields sibling emails (relatives-known), phone.get_current_date_and_time fixes 'yesterday' (date-known), venmo.show_social_feed exposes feed transactions (feed-known). venmo-like-transaction is only applicable to transactions that are on the feed, dated yesterday and involve a sibling, so the plan never likes anything else (the evaluation requires the liked set to be exactly the target set and no new transactions). The number of matching transactions is unknown a priori; the problem uses two placeholder transaction objects (sibling-txn-1/2) and supervisor-complete-task takes them as non-API record parameters (with an inequality) so its precondition equals the task-specific goal. At runtime the agent paginates the feed and instantiates one like call per matching entry. A static token-for fact pins each token object to its app so logins bind the right token. complete_task is called without an answer.
